segments.name: Primary Reporting Segment
segments.description: Aggregates the North America, Latin America, EMEA and Asia Pacific regions, selling nutrition products to Members who consume or resell them.
segments.evidence: We aggregate our operating segments, excluding China, into a reporting segment, or the Primary Reporting Segment.

segments.name: China
segments.description: Sells nutrition products in China through independent service providers and Company-operated retail platforms.
segments.evidence: China has been identified as a separate reporting segment as it does not meet the criteria for aggregation.

revenueModel.text: Independent Members pay wholesale prices for nutrition products, which they consume themselves or resell at retail to consumers.
revenueModel.evidence: We use a direct-selling business model to distribute and market our nutrition products to and through a global network of Members.
